items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I had him working with me one time down in New Orleans

ctx.x: Did he take that from you alright?

Yeah, he said, well alright. But still he'd go on and drink. But I had him working with me one time down in New Orleans and we didn't have to go on until late that night because there was a big fight and everybody was watching the fight on TV, so the man said not to go on until after the fight is over. I said okay. So Scott went back to the bar and he'd be sitting there drinking a mile a minute yacking to the bar tender, and watching the fight. I guess he doesn't realize how much he was drinking. So he got back…
